summary: A fun classic daily with real surprises: Shaq, Hakeem, Rodman and LeBron all miss the top 10, while Elvin Hayes and Robert Parish are in it.
reasons: Casual: Wilt, Russell, Kareem, Duncan, Howard, Garnett and Karl Malone for 7/10; Shaq (#15), Rodman (#24), LeBron (#23), Hakeem (#14) and Ben Wallace cost the five lives on guess 12.
Those misses are the fun of it: famous big men with a rank to learn from. Fans get 10/10 losing only Hakeem and Shaq.
Aliases are good ('malone' offers both Malones, 'kg', 'the mailman', 'kareem'); Blitz scores 13 of 16 casual names.
fixes: Junk redirect aliases on top-10 entries: Dwight Howard 'Royce Reed', 'Dwightmare'; Bill Russell 'Russell rule', "Bill Russell's rule"; Tim Duncan 'Rim Duncan'. Drop redirects naming other people and rules.
